title: Spinach and Mushroom Stuffed Chicken
description: This dish is a good source of protein and also provides some veggies. While quick to prepare, it has an elegant look to it, and guests are sure to be impressed by the presentation and taste!
ingredients: 1/2 cup frozen spinach (chopped, thawed and drained)
4 breasts boneless, skinless chicken breasts (4-ounce each)
4 wedges light garlic and herb cheese
steps: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Spray a baking dish with cooking spray.
Add the oil to a medium sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the spinach and sauté for 3 minutes. Add the mushroom and cook an additional 4-5 minutes. Add the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.

Place one chicken breast on a cutting board and cover it with plastic wrap. Pound the chicken with a meat tenderizer or rolling pin until it is about 1/4-inch thick. Repeat this process for the other 3 chicken breasts.

Spread 1 Laughing Cow cheese wedge on one side of one chicken breast. Spread 1/4 cup of the spinach mushroom mixture on top of the cheese. Roll the chicken breast and secure the seam with a toothpick. Repeat this procedure for the 3 remaining chicken breasts.
Sprinkle the chicken breasts with pepper and paprika. Place the rolled chicken breasts on a baking dish and bake for 30-40 minutes or until done.
To serve, remove the toothpicks and slice each breast into 5 rounds.

title: Citrus Grilled Shrimp with Spring Greens
description: A light and easy dish, this grilled shrimp offers a lot of flavors. It can be eaten on its own or with a side of a nonstarchy dish like cauliflower rice.
steps: In a medium bowl, whisk together orange and lime juice, hot sauce, garlic and pepper. Add shrimp to bowl and place in refrigerator to marinate for 20 minutes.
Prepare an indoor or outdoor grill to medium. Spray grill rack with cooking spray.
Place shrimp on skewers and grill for 2-3 minutes on each side or until shrimp are done.
Serve shrimp on top of spring mix salad with clementine slices.
Whisk together dressing ingredients and pour over shrimp and salad.

title: Mediterranean Vegan Breakfast Bowl
description: Turmeric gives the scrambled tofu a rich yellow color that mimics the look of scrambled eggs and combining it with the garlic powder adds a zesty, savory bite. This filling breakfast bowl is a great way to add vegetables and whole grains to your morning.
ingredients: 2 sprays, 0.5 g nonstick cooking spray (olive oil)
steps: Spray a medium-sized skillet with cooking spray. Place the tofu in the skillet and break it apart with a fork or potato masher. Mix in the turmeric, garlic powder, salt, and 2 Tbsp almond milk. Cook over medium-low heat until warmed through.

In a small bowl, combine the tahini, yogurt, lemon juice, and 1 Tbsp almond milk and mix until combined and the tahini has thinned to a dressing consistency. You can add a little more milk or lemon juice if needed.
Place half of the cauliflower rice and quinoa in a bowl and mix to combine. Add half of the carrots and radishes to the bowl. Repeat with the second bowl.
Spray the kale with the olive oil cooking spray. Rub it into the kale until it is softened and bright green in color. Add half the kale to each bowl.
Divide the scrambled tofu and add half alongside the kale and other vegetables. Drizzle with the dressing.

title: Chili Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Cranberries
description: Our chili-roasted Brussels sprouts features a burst of tart sweetness from cranberries. This colorful dish is a showstopper side to serve at your next holiday get-together.
steps: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F.
In a large bowl, toss the Brussels sprouts with the olive oil, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until well-coated.
Spread the Brussels sprouts in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20–25 minutes or until the Brussels sprouts are golden brown and crispy, stirring them halfway through.
While the Brussels sprouts are roasting, soak the dried cranberries in warm water for 5 minutes to plump them up.
Remove the Brussels sprouts from the oven.
Drain the cranberries and sprinkle them over the roasted Brussels sprouts. Toss gently to combine.
If desired, drizzle balsamic glaze over.

title: Zucchini Fritters with Feta and Dill
description: Crispy Zucchini Fritters pair great with creamy and bright feta cheese and fresh dill for a delicious side dish.
ingredients: 2 med zucchini (grated and squeezed to remove excess moisture)
1/2 cup Plain Nonfat Greek yogurt (for serving)
steps: In a bowl, combine the grated and squeezed zucchini, crumbled feta, chopped dill, flour, salt, pepper, and beaten egg.
Form the mixture into 12 small patties and cook them in a skillet with olive oil until golden brown on both sides, about 3 to 5 minutes per side.
Serve with Greek yogurt.

title: Eggs Benedict Florentine
description:
Here’s a healthy low carb version of Eggs Benedict where the bacon is replaced by perfectly sautéed garlic spinach and the hollandaise sauce is on the lighter side.

The chefs at Homemade have partnered with us for easy-to-follow instructions on how to make this recipe. Watch this recording of our live cooking class to see how to prepare this meal from start to finish.
ingredients: 2 whole whole-wheat English muffins (split and lightly toasted)
steps: To poach eggs, bring about 3 inches of water to boil in a large, shallow skillet over high heat. Turn off the heat and add eggs at once by breaking them directly into the water. Immediately cover pan with a tight-fitting lid. Allow eggs to cook undisturbed until done as desired, about 4 minutes. Remove the eggs with a perforated spatula or large slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Add the cooking spray and oil to a sauté pan over medium heat. Sauté the spinach until wilted. Stir in the garlic and sauté 1 additional minute.

Prepare a double boiler with a heat-proof bowl. Add the egg yolk, lemon juice, and vegetable broth, whisking constantly until hot but not curdled. Remove from heat and whisk in yogurt, salt (optional), and pepper.
Top each English muffin half with 1/4 of spinach mixture, one poached egg, and 2 Tbsps. sauce.

title: Easy Beef Chili
description: This diabetes-friendly dish is filled with lean beef—which provides 10 essential nutrients, including protein and iron—and beans, which provide fiber and more protein. It’s a warming, nutritious meal you can feel good about serving to your entire family. Complete your plate: Top the chili with a dollop of Greek yogurt and Almost Smooth Salsa. Add a veggie-rich side dish, like this Kale Apple Slaw.
ingredients: 1 (15.5-oz) can low-sodium kidney beans (rinsed and drained)
1 (15-oz) can low-sodium cannellini or great northern beans (rinsed and drained)
1 (15.5-oz) can low-sodium black beans (rinsed and drained)
steps: Heat the olive or canola oil in a medium pot over medium heat. When the oil is shimmering, add the onion, garlic, and jalapeño and cook until the onion is translucent and the garlic is fragrant, 3 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, 8 minutes, breaking up the pieces using the back of a wooden spoon while cooking.
Add the remaining ingredients to the pot and stir to combine. Raise the heat to high and bring the mixture to a boil.
Then lower the heat to medium low and simmer, covered, until the beef is cooked through and the flavors combine, 30 minutes. Stir occasionally during cooking time.
Remove the chili from the heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Roasted Beets with Blue Cheese and Hazelnuts
description: This gourmet dish not only showcases vibrant colors, but also adds a sophisticated touch to your diabetes-conscious dining, creating a delightful balance of textures and tastes in every delectable bite.
ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh parsley (chopped, for garnish, optional)
steps: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Prepare a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, toss the diced beets with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until well coated.
Spread the beets in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 45 minutes or until the beets are tender, stirring halfway through.
Remove the beets from the oven and transfer them to a serving dish.
Sprinkle crumbled blue cheese and toasted hazelnuts over the roasted beets.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.

title: Tarragon Herbed Chicken and Mushrooms
description:
A favorite of French cuisine, tarragon adds a fragrant, licorice-like flavor to chicken. If tarragon isn't your thing, try this recipe with another herb like basil, cilantro, or dill. You can also sub dried herbs for fresh: sub 1 teaspoon dried herb for each tablespoon of fresh herb. You can buy thin-cut chicken breast cutlets in the store or buy whole chicken breast and cut them in half to make cutlets that are about 1/2-inch thick. Pair this chicken with Easy Half-Mashed Potatoes with Cauliflower for a diabetes-friendly meal with less carbs, but all the comfort!

Double Up: Cook double the chicken in this recipe and use the leftovers for Easy Chicken Paninis later in the week!
serving_size: 4 oz chicken with 1/3 cup herbed mushrooms
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast cutlets
steps: Coarsely chop the tarragon, parsley, and mushrooms together in a food processor or by hand. Set aside.
Coat a large nonstick skillets with olive oil spray, and heat over medium-high heat.

Brown the chicken breasts for 4 minutes on each side, or until a meat thermometer inserted into the chicken reads 165° F. Remove the chicken from the pan. (if doubling the chicken, cook in two pans; set aside half of the chicken to cool, then store in a tightly sealed container in the fridge for up to 3 days.)
Divide the chicken between 4 dinner plates and sprinkle with the salt and pepper.

Add the olive oil to the pan along with the garlic and chopped herbs and mushrooms. Toss to warm through, about 1 minute. Spoon over the plated chicken. Serve with an additional vegetable or whole grain side dish.

title: Magic Air Fried Chicken Nuggets with Sweet and Sour Sauce
description: What’s magic about these chicken nuggets? The fact that they’re so delicious and diabetes friendly, plus kid approved!
ingredients: 2 whole boneless, skinless chicken breasts (cubed into nugget-sized pieces)
steps: In a small saucepan, combine honey, ketchup, apple cider vinegar, and soy sauce. Heat the mixture over low heat, stirring constantly until well combined and slightly thickened. Remove from heat and set aside.
Mix the chicken with kosher salt, pepper, and lemon juice. You can leave it for 30 minutes to 1 to 2 hours for flavors to develop, although it's not necessary.
Put the flour in a shallow bowl.
Lightly whisk eggs in a separate bowl.
Put crushed cornflakes in another shallow bowl.
Preheat your air fryer to 375 degrees F.
Dip each chicken nugget first into the flour, then into the egg, and finally into the cornflakes mix. Make sure to coat each nugget thoroughly by pressing the cornflakes onto them.
Place the coated chicken nuggets in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Spray oil on the nuggets liberally, covering all surfaces.
Cook at 375 degrees F for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the nuggets are golden and crispy with an internal temperature of 165 degrees F, flipping them over halfway through the cooking time.
Serve the air-fried chicken nuggets with the homemade sweet and sour sauce for dipping.

title: Roasted Pepper Salad
description: Author Robyn Webb says, "Bell peppers are so tasty when they are raw, so why ever mess with them by roasting them? It’s because fire does something incredibly magical to a pepper-it transforms its flavor and texture into something juicier, sweeter, and more versatile than before it stepped into the flames. Roasted peppers jazz up pasta, eggs, soups, stews, homemade pizza, and many more everyday foods."
ingredients: 2 tbsp Extra Virgin Olive Oil (divided use)
1 clove garlic (very finely chopped or crushed)
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Brush the peppers with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and arrange them in a shallow roasting pan. Roast for about 35 minutes or until the pepper skins are evenly darkened, turning them 3 or 4 times. Place the peppers in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and leave until they are cool enough to handle.
Working over a bowl to catch the juice, peel the peppers. Cut them in half and discard the cores and seeds (strain out any seeds that fall into the juice), then cut into thick slices.
Measure 1 ½ tbsp. of the pepper juice into a small bowl (discard the remainder). Add the vinegar and garlic and whisk in the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Arrange the peppers on a serving platter or on individual salad plates. Drizzle with dressing and garnish with the olives and basil.

title: Veggie Breakfast Wrap
description: Packed with protein, antioxidants and fiber, this breakfast will sustain your energy and your hunger all morning. A light egg mixture featuring veggies you have on hand (such as spinach, mushrooms fresh herbs and scallions) is wrapped in a whole grain toasted tortilla and served with salsa.
ingredients: 2 tsp olive oil or other vegetable oil
1/2 cup egg white or egg substitute
1 cup, firmly packed spinach or other greens
2 tbsp chopped scallions or other onion
2 small whole wheat, low-carb flour tortillas
steps: Add olive oil to the skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and sauté until nicely brown at edges (about 3 minutes), set aside.
Beat eggs with egg whites or egg substitute in medium sized bowl, using a mixer or by hand, until blended.
Stir in shredded spinach, and scallions. You could also add fresh or dried herbs such as basil or parsley for more flavor.
Begin heating medium/large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Coat pan generously with cooking spray.
Pour in egg mixture and continue to scramble the mixture as it cooks using a spatula. When eggs are cooked to your liking, turn off the heat and stir in mushrooms.
Spread half of the egg mixture down the center of each tortilla. top each with 1 tablespoon fresh salsa or other sauce of your choice. Then roll it up to make a wrap.

title: Whole Wheat Breakfast Pizzas
description: Try this recipe to spice up your morning routine. It’s a recipe for two, so share it with your special someone for a well-rounded, healthy breakfast.
serving_size: ½ English muffin + ½ cup egg mixture
ingredients: 1 whole whole-wheat English muffins (split in half)
1/4 cup Colby and Monterey Jack cheese mixture (low-fat, shredded)
steps: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F.

In a small nonstick skillet, heat the margarine over medium heat until melted, swirling to coat the bottom. Cook the green onions, mushrooms, and bell pepper over medium-high heat for 3 minutes, or until tender, stirring frequently.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg substitute and milk. Pour over the vegetables. Reduce the heat to medium.

Cook without stirring until the mixture begins to set on the bottom and around the edge. As it sets, push the mixture toward the center of the skillet and tilt the skillet so the uncooked portion flows to the edge and all the egg substitute is fully cooked, 3 to 4 minutes. (A rubber scraper works well for this.)

Put the English muffin halves with the cut side up on a baking sheet. Sprinkle each with 1 Tbsp. Colby and Monterey Jack mixture. Spoon the egg mixture over the cheese. Top with the remaining cheese. Sprinkle with the tomato.
Bake for 5 to 8 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

description: Nutrition information for sugar-free jam

title: No-Bake Peanut Butter & Chocolate Bites
description: Need a healthy snack for your summer road trip? This simple treat is much better for you than any processed snack that you get at a gas station.
steps: In a small saucepan, combine sugar blend and milk over medium heat. Stir well and bring to a boil for 1 1/2 minutes. Stir in peanut butter and vanilla.
Remove from heat and add oats. Stir until oats are evenly coated in the peanut mixture and everything has cooled. Fold in the chocolate chips.
Scoop oat mixture into 1 Tbsp. balls and place on waxed paper. Let cool and refrigerate.

title: Canned Protein Burger
description: You don't need fresh ground meat to make a delicious burger. With this budget-friendly option, you can use any canned meat such as tuna, salmon, or chicken. You could serve this like a traditional burger on a whole-wheat but with cheese, lettuce, and tomato. Or, for a low carb option, serve in a lettuce wrap topped with salsa and avocado. You could also chop up the patties and use them as a filling for a taco or burrito. The patties also freeze well, so you can make a bunch and save for a super quick dinner or lunch.
ingredients: 1 (12-ounce) can canned protein such as tuna, salmon, or chicken
steps: In a bowl, mix together the canned protein, breadcrumbs, lite mayonnaise, onion, bell pepper, egg, salt and pepper until combined. Form the mixture into 6 patties.
Add olive oil to a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Fry burgers on each side for 3-4 minutes. Work in batches if your pan is not big enough to hold all 8 burgers.

Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week or wrap individually in freezer bags or containers and freeze up to 3 months (freeze cooked burgers only, do not freeze the raw burgers).

title: Crispy Buffalo Chickpeas
description: Spice up your snacking routine with our Crispy Buffalo Chickpeas, where humble chickpeas undergo a fiery transformation. They make a great snack at home or your next tailgating party for a side that’s diabetes friendly and delicious.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 ounces each) canned chickpeas (drained and rinsed)
1/2 tsp cayenne pepper (adjust to your preference)
steps: Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F and prepare a baking sheet with parchment paper or a light coating of cooking spray (optional).
Drain and rinse two cans of chickpeas, then gently pat them dry with a paper towel to remove excess moisture. Dry chickpeas will become crispier during roasting.
In a mixing bowl, toss the dried chickpeas with one tablespoon of olive oil, ensuring they are evenly coated.

In another bowl, create a spicy seasoning mixture by combining 1/4 cup of hot sauce, 1/2 teaspoon of garlic powder, 1/2 teaspoon of onion powder, 1/2 teaspoon of paprika, 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper (adjust to your spice preference), and pepper.
Add the seasoned hot sauce mixture to the chickpeas, ensuring they are well-coated with the flavorful seasoning.
Spread the seasoned chickpeas onto the prepared baking sheet, ensuring they are in a single layer.
Bake the chickpeas in the preheated oven for about 55 minutes, or until they become crispy. Be sure to stir or shake the pan every 10-15 minutes for even cooking.
Once the chickpeas are crispy and have absorbed the Buffalo flavor, remove them from the oven and allow them to cool slightly.
